name: ac-behavioral-investing
description: Managing the investor as well as the portfolio: the bias inventory that actually damages long-horizon capital, decision journals written before outcomes, precommitment devices, the information diet and checking frequency, drawdown psychology, social and herd pressure, and the behavioural review that separates process from outcome. It builds discipline; it never recommends a security or predicts returns. Use when asking "behavioural finance", "I panic sold", "decision journal", "how often should I check", "precommitment", "herd behaviour". Not for trade-level risk rails on a crypto desk (ac-crypto-trading-discipline), not for portfolio policy (ac-investment-policy-statement), not for company research (ac-equity-research).
